title: Approvals
intro: Business approvals assigned to you or requested by you.
businessApprovalBody: a business decision inside the product, recorded in the name of the person who makes it (or “B on behalf of A” under an active delegation), with a rationale. The software never decides: a timer only escalates.

type.decision_request: Decision routed by the decision rights matrix
type.governance_matrix_change: Decision rights matrix or RACI change

routingError.no_next_authority: Routing error: no next authority is configured
routingError.party_unmapped: Routing error: the next role is not mapped
routingError.party_not_approver: Routing error: nobody mapped holds the approval right

list.emptyBody: Business approvals assigned to you, your groups or the people you act for appear here.

escalation.title: Escalations
escalation.intro: An overdue approval is escalated once per level along the decision right's escalation chain. Escalation never decides.

history.title: Decision history
history.intro: Every decision of every round, with the record version it was made on.

decide.title: Decide: {{title}}
decide.note: you decide as yourself, or on behalf of someone who delegated to you. Your name is recorded with the rationale.
decide.description: You decide on version {{version}} of the record. If the record changed since, nothing is recorded and you are asked to review it.
decide.outcomeHint: Request changes keeps the approval open for a resubmission; defer asks for a new date.
decide.rationaleHint: Why you decide this way. Required for every outcome.
decide.onBehalfOfHint: Only people with an active delegation to you are listed. Leave empty to decide as yourself.
decide.requesterCannot: You requested this approval, so you cannot decide it (separation of duties).

resubmit.title: Resubmit for approval
resubmit.description: Resubmit after changing the record. The new round is for the record's newer version.
resubmit.versionHint: The current version of the changed record.

withdraw.title: Withdraw this approval request
withdraw.description: The request closes without a decision. This cannot be undone.

records.title: Business approval records
records.intro: Every business approval decision of this transformation: approvals, gate decisions and funding decisions.
records.businessApprovalBody: these are decisions people made inside the product. A decision under a delegation reads “B on behalf of A”.
records.open: Open all approval records of this transformation
